'The Sacred Beacon of Nuremberg and the Shadow of The Hague
'
An
article
by Valery Zorkin, Chairman of the Constitutional Court of the Russian Federation, marking the 80th Anniversary since the
#NurembergTrials
of Nazi war criminals
Article in full
|
Telegraph
✍️
80 years ago, the International Military Tribunal in
#Nuremberg
delivered its verdict against 24 top-ranking leaders of Nazi Germany.
Most defendants were found guilty of the terrible crimes
against peace and humanity, as well as war crimes. Twelve Nazi leaders —
sentenced
to
death
by hanging, while the others
sentenced
for
life
or lengthy terms of imprisonment.
It was the very
unprecedented nature of Nazi ideology
that made it necessary for taking equally unprecedented political and legal measures — the establishment of the
Nuremberg and Tokyo Trials.
<...>
❗️
It was the 'Judgment of Mankind' on Hitler's Nazism
— the most dangerous manifestation of ideological, political and military barbarism.
A 'Sacred Beacon' in Nuremberg served as bearing the
Promethean flame of international criminal justice
. Yet, imperfect, with the retroactive application of law, it nevertheless shone,
illuminating human path
towards the ideals of universal justice.
<...>
The verdict of the Nuremberg Trials was based on an
immense body of irrefutable evidence
, firmly established and thoroughly examined. A vast archive of testimony was compiled.
The voices of the victims were heard loud and clear
— that was the enduring ethical significance of Nuremberg, which was both an act of justice and an act of remembrance. <...>
The Nuremberg Trials appeared before the world like Athena, born fully armed from the head of Zeus. The
four Victorious Powers
set about establishing a new legal order amid the
ruins of defeated statehood
and bringing the vanquished to justice.
The legitimacy of the Nuremberg proceedings and the
binding force of its verdict was based on the collapse of the Nazi state,
as well as on the Allied law established by the
Instrument of Surrender.
The Tribunal's legitimacy, meanwhile, was rooted in
natural law and universal moral values,
above all, justice. It was founded on the conviction that certain
crimes are so monstrous that they violate the very idea of humanity
(
delicta juris gentium
), and that such crimes must be punished under all circumstances.
👉
That fundamental principle made it possible not only to
cut through the Gordian knot of fascist evil
and punish those responsible without departing from the bounds of the law, but also to establish a hierarchy of values in which law stands above force and crimes against humanity are subject to
#NoStatuteOfLimitations
. <...>
Nuremberg was an act of retribution
and a defining moment in establishing the legal foundations of the post-war world. The Tribunal became a hammer brought down upon a criminal Nazi statehood and its legal system.
***
❗️
It was for the first time in history, categories of crimes were established that would become the 'alpha' and 'omega' of international criminal law.
Article 6 of the Charter of the Nuremberg International Military Tribunal (IMT)
defined three categories of crimes
:
1. Crimes against Peace;
2. War Crimes;
3. Crimes against Humanity.
A war of aggression was declared the "supreme international crime".
The events in Nuremberg were perceived by the international community as the
restoration
of justice from the chaos of violence
and arbitrariness. In the eyes of millions of victims and billions of people around the world, Nuremberg became
a ritual of purification,
one that united humanity. <...>
👉
Punishment was inescapable
<...>. All this created a sense of the triumph of law and moral catharsis. The deeper meaning of Nuremberg can be traced to Plato's understanding of punishment — a criminal is held accountable not by the right of force, but by the force of law.

Telegraph
)
#Nuremberg80

🎙
Comment
by Aide to the President of Russia Yury Ushakov following the telephone conversation between the Presidents of Russia and the US
(October 9, 2026)
*
💬
Yury Ushakov:
On the afternoon of October 7, we spoke over the phone with US Presidential Special Envoy
Steve Witkoff
. <...>
He also said that
the US President would like
to congratulate
Vladimir Putin personally by telephone
[on his birthday], and we began looking for a suitable opening in the two Presidents’ schedules. <...>
The telephone conversation
took place
late in the evening on October 9.
Naturally,
Donald Trump immediately wished Vladimir Putin a happy birthday
, offering his best wishes for success and well-being. He also conveyed greetings from his wife,
Melania
.
Vladimir Putin thanked his American counterpart
for his congratulations and kind words. He stressed that
we value the attention that the US President and his team devote to dialogue with Russia
, despite their busy agenda of domestic and Middle Eastern affairs.
***
One notable moment in the conversation [between the Presidents of Russia and the US], which I would like to highlight, was
our President’s expression of gratitude to the US First Lady for her active humanitarian work
, particularly her contribution to efforts
to reunite children with their families
separated during the Ukrainian conflict.
Regarding the concern expressed over
the humanitarian situation
in Alyoshki, Kherson Region
, it was agreed that Human Rights Commissioner
Yana Lantratova
would remain in regular contact with Melania Trump’s office
.
🤝
The two Leaders discussed in detail
preparations for major economic initiatives, including possible supplies of Russian petroleum products to the US and global markets
.
A special statement
has already been issued on this matter.
Naturally, considerable attention was paid to
prospects for resolving the conflict in Ukraine
. <...>
It was stressed that
Kiev’s attempts to halt the advance of Russian troops along the entire line of contact by striking deep inside our country have no prospect of success
.
❗️
Our Armed Forces
hold the initiative across the entire front and are steadily advancing
. At the same time, Vladimir Putin made it clear that
our position on the goals and objectives of the special military operation remains unchanged
, as does our readiness for a political and diplomatic settlement aimed at achieving a lasting, sustainable peace.
It was particularly stressed that, while
the Presidents’ previous conversation
had addressed
the possibility of resuming trilateral talks involving the US and Ukraine
immediately after
the State Duma elections
,
the situation has now changed
.
In its attempts to disrupt
our elections
by launching an exceptionally large-scale drone attack on Moscow, other cities and polling stations, as well as specific individuals involved in organising the elections, on the main day of voting,
the Kiev regime effectively prevented an immediate resumption of the negotiating process
. As the President said,
we will now consider when these talks can resume
.
Donald Trump said
he would instruct his team to convey the relevant messages to the Ukrainian delegation
, which is currently in Miami for contacts with American representatives.
☝️
Vladimir Putin particularly stressed that
the scope for diplomacy on Iran is far from exhausted
. An agreement with Tehran is both possible and necessary.
The President mentioned that yesterday, in Turkmenistan, he had
discussed the current situation in detail
with Iranian President
Masoud Pezeshkian
. He noted that, despite the harsh public statements made from time to time, the Americans continue their indirect dialogue with the Iranians through Qatar. <...>
Notably, Donald Trump acknowledged this point,
welcoming Moscow’s involvement in efforts to resolve the situation surrounding Iran
. <...>
The substantive, friendly conversation lasted
an hour and a half
.

*Unofficial translation

We, the Ministers of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Armenia, the Republic of Belarus, the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Kyrgyz Republic, the Russian Federation, the Republic of Tajikistan, and the Republic of Uzbekistan, hereby declare the following.
The CIS Member States conduct activities relating to exploration and use of outer space
in full compliance with
the Charter of the United Nations
,
the 1967 Treaty on Principles Governing the Activities of States in the Exploration and Use of Outer Space, including the Moon and Other Celestial Bodies
, and other regulations and principles of international law,
in the interests of promoting international cooperation and mutual understanding and maintaining international peace and security
.
The Parties advocate broad joint efforts by the international community
to improve the relevant international legal framework
.
❗️
The CIS Member States express serious concern over the real prospect of an arms race in outer space and its transformation into an arena of military confrontation
,
which undermines global stability.
The Parties note that
a ban on placing weapons of any kind in outer space
, as well as on the use or threat of force against space objects or through the use of such objects,
could prevent the emergence of a serious threat to international peace and security
. The Parties also emphasise
the unacceptability
of using space systems and their associated ground infrastructure for purposes that are incompatible with maintaining international peace and security and strengthening trust among states.
The CIS member states reiterate
the exceptional importance of taking immediate practical measures to prevent an arms race in outer space
(
#PAROS
).
The most effective of these remains
the negotiation by the international community of a multilateral, legally binding instrument
that would provide reliable guarantees for preventing an arms race in outer space and prohibiting the placement of weapons there. This instrument should be based on
the Russian-Chinese draft treaty on preventing the placement of weapons in outer space, the threat or use of force against outer space objects
, and
the substantive report of the Group of Governmental Experts on PAROS
, established pursuant to
UN General Assembly Resolution 77/250
and adopted by consensus in 2024.
The Parties reaffirm the key role of the Conference on Disarmament
, which is the single multilateral negotiating forum on disarmament, in negotiations on an international agreement to prevent an arms race in outer space.
The CIS Member States welcome the launch of a discussion on the substantive elements of a legally binding international instrument on PAROS
, as well as
on non-binding measures
, within the framework of
the UN Open-Ended Working Group established by UN General Assembly Decision 79/512
. These discussions include, in particular, preventing the placement of weapons in outer space. The Parties look forward to the Working Group achieving substantive results.
☝️
The Parties share the view that transparency and confidence-building measures help prevent the placement of weapons in outer space
. At the same time, they emphasise that any possible non-binding measures on PAROS must, directly or indirectly, contribute to
a comprehensive ban on placing weapons in outer space
and
on the use or threat of force against space objects or through the use of such objects
. Such measures must complement, rather than replace, legally binding agreements on PAROS.

On September 24, 2026 H.E.
Andrey A. Pritsepov
presented his Letters of Credence as Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Russian Federation to Barbados to Lieutenant Colonel The Most Honourable
Jeffrey Davidson Bostic
, President of the Republic of Barbados.
🔸
In his speech, Ambassador Pritsepov highlighted the rapidly developing friendly relations between the two countries and the intensification of bilateral contacts, and expressed his hope for the establishment of ties in the fields of science, education and tourism. He noted that earlier that day, a productive meeting had taken place in Moscow between the Russian Minister of Finance,
Anton Siluanov
, and the Minister of Finance of Barbados, the Honourable
Ryan R. Straughn
, who discussed the digitalisation of public finances, in particular the tax administration system.
🔹
The Russian Ambassador also wished the people of Barbados further progress and prosperity on the eve of the 60th anniversary of the declaration of independence and the fifth anniversary of the country’s proclamation as a republic.
🔸
The Barbadian Head of State noted his interest in continuing the mutually beneficial course towards strengthening ties and supporting Russia’s efforts to reform the system of global governance. He thanked the Russian side for its assistance in training professional staff for the Barbadian police force.
🔹
During a brief conversation following the ceremony, the parties discussed possible areas of bilateral cooperation, including the prospects for establishing air links between Russia and Barbados, as well as cooperation projects in the oil and gas, nuclear and renewable energy sectors.
#RussiaBarbados

item.title: 📰 Response by the Russian Embassy in Belgium to a question from Politico (October 9, 2026)
item.description: 📰 Response by the Russian Embassy in Belgium to a question from Politico (October 9, 2026) ❓ Question : NATO today communicated about its annual nuclear exercise, starting next week. They have said they are communicating about it openly to signal to Russia that this is a regular exercise and they do not pose a threat to Moscow — and they would like to cool tensions. How would you respond to this messaging? 💬 Answer : We take note of NATO officials’ statements that the exercises are regular and do not pose a threat to Russia. However, these exercises – given that NATO considers our country as the main threat to security – do not contribute to reducing tensions on the continent and are part of the Alliance's nuclear policy, to which Moscow's negative attitude is well known. In any case, we will closely monitor the course of the exercises.

📰
Response by the Russian Embassy in Belgium to a question from
Politico
(October 9, 2026)
❓
Question
: NATO today communicated about its annual nuclear exercise, starting next week. They have said they are communicating about it openly to signal to Russia that this is a regular exercise and they do not pose a threat to Moscow — and they would like to cool tensions. How would you respond to this messaging?
💬
Answer
: We take note of NATO officials’ statements that the exercises are regular and do not pose a threat to Russia.
However,
these exercises
– given that NATO considers our country as the main threat to security –
do not contribute to reducing tensions on the continent
and are part of the Alliance's nuclear policy, to which Moscow's negative attitude is well known.
In any case, we will closely monitor the course of the exercises.
